demo.title: memogram.sh
demo.code:
# Read every memo in a transaction, joined to its payment
bankr prompt "Using the memogram skill, read the memos in tx 0xf726…1c4f"

# Read an address's recent memos
bankr prompt "Using the memogram skill, show the last 10 memos from 0xYourAddr"

# Send a payment with an on-chain memo attached
bankr prompt "Using the memogram skill, send 1 MEMO to 0xFriend with the memo 'gm from bankr'"

setup: Set up the memo-mcp server, pinned to a reviewed revision — v0.2.1 (commit 2c2c663): https://github.com/GeObts/memo-mcp
Read-only needs no key and has no spend surface — prefer it unless sends are required
For sends: MEMO_PRIVATE_KEY must be a FRESH dedicated key that has never held real value, funded minimally, run over local stdio only — never hosted, remote, or shared
For sends: both spend caps MEMO_MAX_PER_SEND and MEMO_MAX_TOTAL are mandatory — the server refuses to boot with a key and no caps
memo-mcp is first-party (same author as this skill) and is NOT audited — review the source before enabling sends
Sends always require an explicit user confirmation of a preview_send; there is no auto-send
